FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Climate Control Solutions provides comprehensive heating, ventilation, air conditioning (HVAC), and cooling services primarily for residential and small commercial clients. Our operations include the installation, maintenance, and repair of HVAC systems, ensuring optimal indoor climate control and energy efficiency. We pride ourselves on employing only certified and licensed technicians who undergo regular training to stay updated with industry standards and practices.

Our business maintains a strong focus on safety, adhering to all local and federal regulations, including the EPA Section 608 for refrigerant handling. We implement written safety and training programs for all staff, ensuring compliance and fostering a culture of safety awareness. With a commitment to quality service, we utilize digital scheduling and customer communication tools to enhance customer satisfaction and minimize service errors.

Additionally, our fleet is well-maintained, equipped with necessary safety features, and regularly serviced to ensure reliable and safe transportation during service calls. We also carry out preventive maintenance programs, which help reduce emergency callouts and system failures for our clients, reflecting our proactive approach to HVAC care.

Overall, Climate Control Solutions is dedicated to providing exceptional service with an emphasis on safety, quality, and customer satisfaction in the heating and cooling industry.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Energy Efficiency Solutions, LLC provides consulting services focused on improving energy efficiency for residential and small commercial HVAC systems.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a residential HVAC service call resulted in water damage due to a burst pipe, leading to an estimated loss of $2,500. The claim was resolved, and the loss is closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and security cameras installed around the business premises to deter burglaries and unauthorized access.
